Tobias, I replied in the thread under your message. The site is **Southgate**. Priyanka's updates from 3 Sep 2025 say label printing stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots, with Southgate dispatch holding stacked totes by door 4. She later confirmed labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

The channel doesn't give a street address or site code. If the customer call needs those, ask Priyanka or Hollis.
